FlowerPainter.UI.Manage.DissolveText: Keep all roads, plants and facilities. Release this area for new selections. Its pieces can be edited individually, but the group cannot be restored.
FlowerPainter.UI.Manage.DissolveTip: Keep the built elements and release the area for new selections.
FlowerPainter.UI.Rules.ForceTip: Ignore all selection stops and select a new area over existing groups. Existing buildings stay protected during construction.
FlowerPainter.Hint.Dissolved: Area dissolved. Built elements kept; its footprint is available for new selections.
FlowerPainter.Problem.DissolveFailed: This area cannot be dissolved while it is being built or removed.
